title: Grant a graveyard ability whose cost is the card's own mana value
clause: "Each outlaw creature card in your graveyard has encore {X}, where X is its mana value." (Graywater's Fixer)
why: game/zone_grants.go grants a fixed catalog bundle to cards in a zone (Satoru Umezawa's ninjutsu {2}{U}{B}); ActivatedAbility.Cost is a fixed value (effects/encore.go Encore(cost string) builds ManaCost(cost)+ExileThis). There is no per-card cost on a granted bundle, and the granted row must work from the graveyard for a card that does not print encore.
checked: grep 'has encore|have encore': 0; read game/zone_grants.go header and effects/encore.go; grep for a cost func on ActivatedAbility (CostFor|ManaCostFunc|Generic(Func|For)) in game/activated.go and mana_cost.go: 0; 'where X is its mana value' hits are effects, not ability costs. Underworld Breach's granted escape (cast_permission.go:3111) is a cast permission priced at the mana cost, a different door.

cards.name: Graywater's Fixer
cards.oracle_text: Each outlaw creature card in your graveyard has encore {X}, where X is its mana value. (Exile it and pay its encore cost: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.)
